verses.english: The Exterior as Suffering in the Three Times

verses.pali: “Rūpā, bhikkhave, dukkhā atītā anāgatā paccuppannā. Saddā … gandhā … rasā … phoṭṭhabbā … dhammā dukkhā atītā anāgatā paccuppannā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, in the past … future … present sights, sounds, smells, tastes, touches, and ideas are suffering …”
